Quest: FetchWood03
DisplayName: Collect Firewood for a Witch Burning
-- Message panels
QRC:

QuestorOffer:  [1000]
<ce> You look like you don't mind getting your hands dirty!
<ce> I have a spot of work, if you're interested?
<--->
<ce> How do you feel about doing some honest
<ce> salt-of-the-earth labor, %ra?
<ce> It pays well.
<--->
<ce> I'm in need of someone willing to do some
<ce> menial but well paid laboring!
<ce> Might you fit the bill?

RefuseQuest:  [1001]
<ce> That's the trouble with people these days.
<ce> Afraid of good old-fashioned hard work.
<--->
<ce> I should have known better than to ask a %ra!

AcceptQuest:  [1002]
<ce> We're running short of firewood, you see.
<ce> And we have a very important Witch burning scheduled
<ce> in =deadline_ days, so you simply must get us six
<ce> wood bundles before that day has passed.
<ce> I'll reward you with _reward_ gold if you do this.
<ce> Spare me the details of how you get them ...
<ce> just be sure you get them to me in time for
<ce> the Witch Burning.
<--->
<ce> I really need to source a large amount of firewood.
<ce> We have a very exciting Witch Burning coming up,
<ce> you see. In =deadline_ days time.
<ce> I need you to get six wood bundles at least, to make
<ce> sure that fire burns nice and strong and bright.
<ce> Get them to me before the deadline and
<ce> I'll pay you _reward_ gold.

QuestFail:  [1003]
<ce> You have failed to get _questgiver_
<ce> %g3 firewood in time!

QuestComplete:  [1004]
<ce> Oh, good job, %pcn.
<ce> These six wood bundles will make sure
<ce> that Witch will burn good!
<ce> Here's your _reward_ gold as promised.
<--->
<ce> My firewood ... nicely chopped and everything!
<ce> Well done, %pcn. 
<ce> %oth, that Witch will burn now!
<ce> Here's your _reward_ gold.

QuestorPostsuccess:  [1008]
Hello %pcf. You did a fine job getting me that wood for the Witch Burning. How can I help you?

QuestLogEntry:  [1010]
%qdt
_questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
at ___questgiver_
has asked me to collect six wood bundles
before =deadline_ days have passed.
I will be paid _reward_ gold for all six of them.

Message:  1011
%qdt
_questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
at ___questgiver_
paid me _reward_ gold for six wood bundles.

Message:  1012
<ce> You don't have the six wood bundles I asked for.
<ce> Come back when you have them all ...
<ce> and not before.
<--->
<ce> Stop waisting my time, %pcn!
<ce> Come back when you have the six wood bundles.

Message:  1013
<ce> You have the six wood bundles
<ce> that _questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
<ce> at ___questgiver_ requires.


QBN:

Person _questgiver_ group Questor

Clock _deadline_ 72:00

Item _reward_ gold range 600 to 800

--	Quest start-up:
	log 1010 step 0
	start timer _deadline_

variable _deadline_

_questgiverclicked_ task:
	clicked npc _questgiver_

_gotitem_ task:
	player possesses 6 items class 20 subclass 1604
	say 1013

_success_ task:
	when _questgiverclicked_ and _gotitem_
	player handsover 6 items class 20 subclass 1604
	give pc _reward_
    remove log step 0
	log 1011 step 1
	clear _questgiverclicked_
	end quest

_failure_ task:
	when _questgiverclicked_ and not _gotitem_
	say 1012
	clear _questgiverclicked_

_timeout_ task:
	when _deadline_ and not _success_
	say 1003
    remove log step 0
	end quest
